title: 第09章 被忽悠瘸了的姜恒宇第10章 人皇出关叶凡首次接触修行之路
slug: 遮天刚成天帝聊天群什么鬼
content_zh:
“曝照？”
姜恒宇微微一愣。
他大概明白了这句话的意思。
“这位无上的奔驰大帝是要看看我长什么样子吗？”
姜恒宇略微迟疑。
他在群聊功能里面找到了一个‘群聊直播（新）’的模块，然后用拍照的功能发了一张自拍在群聊里面。
自拍中——
一名俊朗的白衣男子不苟言笑的端坐着，他的身形修长挺拔，面容俊朗，剑眉星目，丰神如玉，一双深邃的眼眸闪烁着星光，一袭浓郁的黑发散落，宛若谪仙降临。
在他的身边。
隐约能够看见一名娇媚的仙子。
仙子的衣衫半解，肌肤白腻，修长的玉手轻轻点在姜恒宇的身上，一抹春光若隐若现……
【发送！】
姜恒宇刚刚点击发送。
他的心中就有些后悔了，坏了，自己在**楼里头自拍，会不会让这位无上的奔驰大帝觉得他很轻挑啊！？
这可是一位大帝啊！
一位活着的大帝啊！真正的古之大帝啊！
姜恒宇突然有些慌了。
他连忙补救的发了一句话。
【人欲道祖师爷：前辈勿怪，我有一位好友正在**楼里与仙子论道，是他非要拉着我来的……】
发完过后。

姜恒宇的心中松了口气。
他默默的看着身边好兄弟的古华。
心想——死道友不死贫道，兄弟，哥们我为找来了一位古之大帝的瞩目，不用多谢。
“嗯？”
古华搂着怀里的仙子。
他有些摸不着头脑的看了一眼姜恒宇。
“你特娘看我作甚？”
“看仙子啊！”
姜恒宇冷哼一声：“我辈修士，岂可被女色所束缚？”
说罢。
他站起身来。
任由身边的娇媚仙子帮自己穿戴好衣物。
然后转身离去。
古华挑挑眉。
他冲着旁边的仙子道：“仙子见谅，我这位兄弟今天应该是状态不好，他平常都是一夜七次的。”
闻言。
仙子笑而不语。
吹牛逼谁不会啊！？
古华有些无趣的收回目光。
吹牛逼？

他还真没吹牛逼！
他这位兄弟姜恒宇的实力真的牛逼！
如果御女三千能够飞升？
恐怕姜恒宇现在已经飞升了！
content_en:
"Exposed photo?"
Jiang Hengyu was slightly startled.
He probably understood the meaning of this sentence.
"Does this supreme Mercedes-Benz emperor want to see what I look like?"
Jiang Hengyu hesitated slightly.
He found a 'Group Chat Live (New)' module in the group chat function, and then used the camera function to post a selfie in the group chat.
Taking a selfie——
A handsome man in white clothes sat upright without a smile. He had a slender figure, a handsome face, sword-shaped eyebrows and star-like eyes, and a pair of deep eyes shining with starlight. His rich black hair was scattered, as if he had descended from an immortal.
By his side.
A charming fairy can be vaguely seen.
The fairy's clothes were half unbuttoned and her skin was white and greasy. Her slender jade hands gently touched Jiang Hengyu's body, and a hint of spring light was faintly visible...
【Send! 】
Jiang Hengyu just clicked send.
He felt a little regretful in his heart. Damn it, taking a selfie in the hotel building would make the supreme Mercedes-Benz emperor think that he is very frivolous! ?
This is a great emperor!
A living emperor! The real ancient emperor!
Jiang Hengyu suddenly panicked.
He hurriedly sent a remedial sentence.
[Master of the Way of Human Desire: Don’t blame me, senior, I have a good friend who is discussing Taoism with the fairy in the ** building, and he insisted on dragging me here...]
After sending.
Jiang Hengyu felt relieved.
He silently looked at his good brother Gu Hua beside him.
I thought to myself - a dead Taoist friend is not a poor Taoist, brother, brother, I have attracted the attention of an ancient emperor, no need to thank you.
"Huh?"
Gu Hua hugged the fairy in his arms.
He glanced at Jiang Hengyu with some confusion.
"What do you think I'm doing, mother-in-law?"
"Look at the fairy!"
Jiang Hengyu snorted coldly: "How can monks like us be bound by female lust?"
Say it.
He stood up.
Let the charming fairy beside you help you get dressed.
Then turned and left.
Gu Hua raised his eyebrows.
He said to the fairy next to him: "Fairy, please forgive me, my brother must be in a bad state today. He usually does it seven times a night."
Hear the words.
The fairy smiled and said nothing.
Who can’t brag? ?
Gu Hua withdrew his gaze with some boredom.
Bragging?
He really wasn’t bragging!
His brother Jiang Hengyu is really awesome!
What if Three Thousand Queens could ascend?
I'm afraid Jiang Hengyu has ascended now!
